3. **[Conservative negative-mass flows](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/07_positive_theta_primitives/jensen/notes/03_conservative_negative_mass_flows/01_INITIAL_BRANCH_EVALUATION_20261101.md):** An explicit theta-based conservative diffusion has global existence and exponential mixing. 4. **[Paired source/test deformations](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/07_positive_theta_primitives/jensen/notes/04_paired_source_test_deformations/01_INITIAL_BRANCH_EVALUATION_20261101.md):** The Darboux pairing preserves all required moments and the determinant, including boundary and forcing terms. 5. **[Source flows and Jensen hyperbolicity](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/07_positive_theta_primitives/jensen/notes/05_source_flows_and_jensen_hyperbolicity/01_INITIAL_BRANCH_EVALUATION_20261101.md):** The reflection-compatible flow reaches a real-rooted limiting family for each fixed degree and shift, using the classical [orthogonal-polynomial zero property](https://dlmf.nist.gov/18.2.vi). Returning toward theta requires backward preservation, which fails generically—even for smooth positive even sources. No failure on the actual theta orbit is claimed; its additional mixed-moment estimate remains unresolved.
